about_the_game:
Dragon Puncher is a single-player arcade-style action game designed to be a training tool for Street Fighter and 2D fighting game enthusiasts, and a well-rounded short game. About 15-20 minutes in length, players typically perform 50-75 dragon punch moves per play-through.

Unleash Your Inner Fighter with Dragon Puncher!

  • Arcade-Style Action: Engage in fast-paced, single-player gameplay that captures the essence of classic arcade fighters.

  • Perfect Your Moves: Designed as a training tool for Street Fighter and 2D fighting game enthusiasts, it's ideal for honing your dragon punch techniques.

  • Quick, Intense Sessions: Each playthrough lasts about 15-20 minutes, during which you'll execute 50-75 dragon punches, offering a compact yet exhilarating experience.

  • Full Controller Support: Enjoy seamless gameplay with full controller compatibility, making every move feel natural and responsive.

  • Coming Soon: Stay tuned for the official release and get ready to punch your way to victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: OS: Windows 10 64-Bit, Windows 11 64-Bit, Windows 7 - 64-Bit Service Pack 1
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 2 Quad CPU Q6600 2.40 GHz (4 CPUs) or AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor (4 CPUs) 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® 9800 GT (1GB), AMD HD 4870 (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 10 compatible
